risks.risk: Valve or cylinder may leak or fail a pressure/safety test
risks.proof: A video showing a soapy-water leak test on the valve and seams, or a recent inspection certificate
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified safe, i.e., at the low end of comparable used 12.5kg cylinders

risks.risk: Cylinder may be past its recertification/expiry date (common safety requirement for refillable cylinders)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped test/recertification date on the collar or base
risks.if_unproven: priced as if date is unknown/expired, lowering value to worst case

risks.risk: Actual tare weight/capacity may differ from claimed 12.5kg due to wear or modification
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped tare weight (TW) on the cylinder collar
risks.if_unproven: priced as base 12.5kg type only, not premium for confirmed spec

risks.risk: Hidden dents, corrosion, or thread damage on the unseen side/base
risks.proof: Additional photos of the base, underside, and all sides of the cylinder
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-wear used unit, not 'neatly used' or premium condition
